# Lund University Publications (LUP)

> > A comprehensive repository of research publications from Lund University covering medical physics, clinical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, materials engineering, cryptography, and natural sciences.

LUP (lup.lub.lu.se) serves as the institutional repository for Lund University, archiving peer-reviewed research across diverse disciplines. The collection features significant contributions in nuclear medicine radiation dosimetry, clinical biomarker research, quantum physics, and archaeological studies from departments including Medical Radiation Physics, Clinical Chemistry and Pharmacology, and various research divisions across Lund and Malmö campuses.

## Key Topics

- Nuclear medicine and radiation dosimetry
- Medical imaging (SPECT, radionuclides)
- Clinical chemistry and pharmacology
- Internal dosimetry with radioisotopes (thallium-201, thallium-204, iodine-125)
- Finite element analysis and magnetostriction
- Pharmaceutical formulation optimization
- Quantum-well wire structures
- Stream cipher cryptanalysis
- Tumor biology and biomarkers
- Environmental toxicology
- Plant stress physiology
- Archaeological research methods
- Lipid biochemistry and cell signaling
- Orthopedic surgery outcomes
- Lichen phylogenetics

## Medical Physics and Nuclear Medicine

- [Radiation dosimetry in nuclear medicine](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1115063): Nuclear medicine radiation dosimetry research by Ljungberg, Strand et al.

## Clinical Chemistry and Biomarker Research

- [Rapid exponential elimination of free prostate-specific antigen contrasts the slow, capacity-limited elimination of PSA complexed to alpha 1-antichymotrypsin from serum](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1112943): PSA elimination kinetics study by Björk, Ljungberg, Piironen et al.
- [Secretion of cathepsin B and tumor invasion](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1108613): Cathepsin B role in tumor invasion by Abrahamson et al.
- [Molecular analysis of simple variant translocations in acute promyelocytic leukemia](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1108702): APL variant translocation analysis by Borrow, Shipley et al.

## Pharmaceutical and Analytical Chemistry

- [Optimization of disintegration time and crushing strength of a tablet formulation](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/4897268): Pharmaceutical tablet optimization by Lindberg, Jönsson, Holmquist
- [Separation of Polyphosphoinositides Using Normal-Phase High-Performance Liquid Chromatography and Evaporative Light Scattering Detection or Electrospray Mass Spectrometry](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/126153): HPLC-MS lipid analysis method by Gunnarsson, Karlsson, Odham et al.
- [Ammoxidation of toluene over molybdenum oxides](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/3917025): Catalytic ammoxidation research by Andersson & Hansen

## Cell Biology and Neuroscience

- [Bradykinin effects on phospholipid metabolism and its relation to arachidonic acid turnover in neuroblastoma x glioma hybrid cells (NG 108-15)](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1104762): Bradykinin signaling in NG108-15 cells by Simonsson, Sun, Alling et al.
- [Ethanol exposure increases expression of c-jun and junD in human neuroblastoma cells](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1109864): Ethanol effects on gene expression by Ding, Larsson, Alling
- [Prompt epithelial damage and restitution processes in allergen challenged guinea-pig trachea in vivo](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1112495): Airway epithelial damage study by Erjefält, Persson et al.

## Clinical Medicine and Surgery

- [Arthrodesis of the ankle secondary to replacement](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1113522): Ankle arthrodesis outcomes study by Carlsson, Montgomery, Besjakov
- [Impaction of cancellous bone grafts impairs osteoconduction in titanium chambers](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1113097): Bone graft impaction effects by Tägil & Aspenberg
- [Contradictory effects of dopamine at 32 degrees C in pigs anesthetized with ketamine](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1112237): Dopamine effects under hypothermia by Roscher, Ingemansson et al.

## Physics and Engineering

- [Finite elements solutions to magnetostriction. - II. Transient and non-linear modelling](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1513092): Finite element analysis of magnetostriction by Weston & Cedell
- [Reevaluation of blueshifts introduced by lateral confinement in quantum-well wire structures](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/35815): Quantum-well wire blueshift analysis by Gustafsson, Samuelson et al.
- [Improved fast correlation attacks on stream ciphers via convolutional codes](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1157341): Stream cipher cryptanalysis by Johansson & Jönsson

## Environmental and Natural Sciences

- [UV-B as an environmental factor in plant life: stress and regulation](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/134463): UV-B radiation effects on plants by Rozema, Björn, Caldwell et al.
- [DDT-fate in tropical and temperate regions](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1023147): DDT environmental fate study by Larsson, Berglund, Backe, Bremle
- [Group I intron versus ITS sequences in phylogeny of cetrarioid lichens.](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/2155837): Lichen phylogeny molecular analysis by Thell
- [Comments on Remodelling the Neolithic in Southern Norway](http://lup.lub.lu.se/record/1982848): Archaeological review on Southern Norway Neolithic by Jennbert
